preconditions.description: The dimensions of the field are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in field)
preconditions.description: Each row of the field has the same width.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in ['#', '.'] for row in field for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the field is either '#' or '.'.

postconditions.expression: all(cell != '.' for row in field for cell in row)
postconditions.description: All cells in the field are filled.

postconditions.expression: all(cell == '#' or cell.isdigit() for row in field for cell in row)
postconditions.description: Each cell is either '#' or a digit representing a figure.

postconditions.expression: all(field[i][j] == field[i][j+1] or field[i][j] == '#' or field[i][j+1] == '#' for i in range(n) for j in range(m-1))
postconditions.description: Adjacent horizontal cells are either the same figure or one of them is '#'.

postconditions.expression: all(field[i][j] == field[i+1][j] or field[i][j] == '#' or field[i+1][j] == '#' for i in range(n-1) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: Adjacent vertical cells are either the same figure or one of them is '#'.
